description: This file implements management functions for WiFi applications, including event handling, app registration, initialization, and deinitialization within a WiFi management system. It handles app-specific events, supports detached thread execution, and manages app descriptors and their lifecycle.

methods.name: get_app_by_inst
methods.description: Retrieves a WiFi application instance from the apps manager based on the application instance ID.

methods.name: app_detached_event_func
methods.description: Thread function that processes events for a detached WiFi app, waiting on condition variables and dequeuing events.

methods.name: push_event_to_app_queue
methods.description: Clones and pushes an event into the application's event queue, signaling the condition variable.

methods.name: apps_mgr_event
methods.description: Handles incoming WiFi events, dispatching them to specific apps based on unicast or broadcast logic.

methods.name: apps_mgr_analytics_event
methods.description: Creates and dispatches an analytics event to the analytics app instance.

methods.name: apps_mgr_sm_event
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a state machine event to the SM app instance.

methods.name: apps_mgr_cac_event
methods.description: Creates and dispatches a CAC (Channel Access Control) event to the CAC app instance, copying message data.

methods.name: app_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes a WiFi app, cancelling its thread if detached.

methods.name: app_init
methods.description: Initializes a WiFi app, setting up synchronization primitives and starting the event thread if detached.

methods.name: update_rfc_params
methods.description: Updates RFC parameters in the app descriptor based on database values, if supported.

methods.name: app_register
methods.description: Registers a new WiFi app with the apps manager, initializing it if RFC is enabled.

methods.name: apps_mgr_update
methods.description: Calls the update function for a WiFi app.

methods.name: apps_mgr_init
methods.description: Initializes the apps manager with a set of app descriptors.
